name: Reasoning Lab Peds normal values
provenance: Built after 30 April 2026. No text from the disclosed 30 April 2026 cases or templates.

age_band.label: 10 months
age_band.note: One band for now, matched to Megan Morris. Add bands as cases need them.

how_to_use: Entries with status 'authored' are descriptive normal findings written for this platform and shown to learners. Entries with status 'needs-source' hold no numbers and are not shown. Numeric reference ranges are added only after they are checked against a retrieved source, then status becomes 'verified' and source fields are filled. A case's own abnormal values always override anything here.

status_key.authored: Descriptive normal written for the platform. Not a numeric claim. Tag AUTHORED.
status_key.needs-source: Numbers wanted, none verified yet. Not displayed.
status_key.verified: Value checked against a retrieved source and cited in 'source'.

candidate_sources.use: Pediatric chemistry reference intervals by age (CALIPER)
candidate_sources.note: Overview of the CALIPER program. Confirms age-partitioned intervals exist and that they are platform dependent. It does not itself list the 9 to 12 month values. Age-band tables are in the primary CALIPER papers.

candidate_sources.use: Heart rate and respiratory rate centiles by age
candidate_sources.note: Fleming et al., Lancet 2011. Retrieved text gave overall medians only. Age-band centiles sit in tables and figures not yet read.

exam_normals.title: Musculoskeletal and joints
lines: Moves all four limbs equally. No joint swelling, warmth, or tenderness. Full passive range of motion.

exam_normals.title: Hips
lines: Hips stable with symmetric abduction. No click or clunk.

exam_normals.title: Back and spine
lines: Spine straight. No sacral dimple, tuft, or midline tenderness.

exam_normals.title: Anus and perianal area
lines: Anus patent and normally positioned. No fissure, no perianal rash.

exam_normals.title: Development
lines: Sits without support, babbles, reaches for objects. Appropriate for age.

exam_normals.title: Umbilicus
lines: Healed. No erythema, discharge, or hernia.
